title: Korea: Gyeonggi north and east
description: Gyeonggi north and east coverage pass (2026-10-12): Goyang (Ilsan), Paju, Gimpo, Uijeongbu, Yangju, Dongducheon, Pocheon, Yeoncheon, Namyangju, Guri, Hanam, Gapyeong, Yangpyeong; 24 Gyeonggi gyms in Bouldeer before this pass (about 130 estimated province-wide).
